title: Cyriak's Animations
content: Cyriak is an animator whose videoCows & Cows & Cowshas logged more than 25 million views.His videos typically show animals moving to a dance beat through increasingly surrealistic transformations. The results are cute, disturbing, and mesmerizing.In this documentary, we meet the artist in his Brighton, England studio and visit his sources of inspiration: video games in the local arcade, pickled specimens in the museum, and animal antics on a local farm.His process starts with digitally cut-out photos and stock videos, animated with Adobe Aftereffects.Cyriak's latest video is called Chimpnology
